name: Halden's Last Hunt
summary: A dead trapper's journal says the forest answers in his own voice. Find out what is using it.

stages.journal: We took Halden Wreath's journal off his corpse. He chased the Tall Man here, and the last page says the forest talks back.
stages.hint: Read the journal and follow the trail it describes.

stages.journal: The trail leads to a ridge of dead trees east of the hollow, where the screams come from.
objectives: Find the source of the screams
stages.hint: Find the owlbears' den on the ridge.

stages.journal: Two rotting owlbears were copying Halden's last scream. We learned what they were and what they copied.
